text:
maria: pagerbot alerted about ~600 auth failures from 52.12.34.56 and found a log snippet in s3 that looks like hashed tokens. suspect dev svc account leak. snippet below (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T13:58:11Z auth INFO user=svc-deploy token_hash=6f1a2b... (truncated) src=52.12.34.56
```
Notified infra and paging sec-oncall. Any immediate mitigations?

rahul: seeing same in edge-proxy, spike started ~13:56 UTC. IP resolves to EU provider. pushing WAF block now. :lock:

ingrid: created bridge https://zoom/incident-3361234567 and started secure channel. ops-lead joining. pagerbot created incident record.

sre-pagerbot: :rotating_light: Auto-created INC-2026-3361234567 (auth-suspect). Pages sent to sec-oncall, infra.

sec-oncall: I'm on it, taking lead. Immediate plan: 1) block IP at edge (rahul) 2) disable svc-deploy access keys 3) rotate KMS/SSM secrets used by svc-deploy 4) snapshot artifacts for forensics. Rahul confirm blocking + which keys to revoke.

rahul: WAF block pushed, confirmed connection drop. Found active access key for svc-deploy (AKIAxxxx). Starting revoke: `aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id AKIAxxxx --status Inactive --user-name svc-deploy` then will create new keys if needed.

ingrid: snapshotting s3://redwood-prod-logs/auth (copy to secure bucket) and saving index with preserved metadata. writing notes to /secure/incidents/INC-2026-3361234567/notes.md

ops-lead: quick customer-impact check: no increase in 5xxs, small uptick in internal background job 401s. No user-facing failures reported. Monitoring dashboards updated.

maria: do we need to rotate model-serving secrets? they are mounted via Secrets Manager on serving nodes.

sec-oncall: yes rotate those. Prefer new CMK + re-encrypt flow for minimal blast radius. Plan: create new CMK alias/redwood/inc-3361, re-encrypt SSM params and SecretManager values, restart pods to pick up short-lived creds. Rahul can you perform KMS steps?

rahul: creating CMK now. workflow: `aws kms create-key --description "inc-3361234567"` -> `aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/inc-3361 --target-key-id <id>` -> re-encrypt secrets and update secret versions. I'll script it and post commands to the bridge.

legal: please preserve chain-of-custody for the log snippet; do not circulate outside the secure channel. I need a timeline of actions and a list of affected principals and customers.

maria: copying container metadata, stack traces, and access logs to the secure bucket, redacting tokens in any external notes. :white_check_mark:

ops-lead: drafting customer-safe messaging: "We detected suspicious auth activity linked to a service account. Rotations and containment in progress. No evidence of customer data access at this time." will run by legal for sign-off.

sre-pagerbot: checklist posted in bridge: rahul=revokes+KMS, maria=forensics+redaction, ingrid=snapshots+notes, ops-lead=customer-message draft. Assigning owners.

maria: prepping handoff to night on-call. Handoff ETA 18:00 UTC. Will include list of rotated keys + commands executed.

sec-oncall: taking handoff at 18:00 UTC. I'll monitor for 6 hours, watch for replay attempts, verify all rotations complete, and confirm no new auth spikes. If we see repeat attempts or user-facing errors, escalate to P0 and notify customers.

rahul: posting rotation commands and status in the bridge now. `aws iam update-access-key` done for svc-deploy, creating new service role creds and updating SecretManager. Re-encryption 40% complete.

ingrid: forensic snapshot complete, hash snippet preserved in secure vault, redacted copy placed in notes. timeline timestamps recorded.

legal: acknowledged. will review wording and advise on notification thresholds.

ops-lead: monitoring dashboards show auth attempts back to baseline. no downstream errors. closing initial containment actions, keeping incident open for monitoring.

maria: thanks all — handing to sec-oncall for overnight watch. :thumbsup:

sec-oncall: thanks, taking over. will post hourly updates. :eyes:
